# OM GROUP

> OM GROUP is a Goa, India construction-materials company. It supplies crushed stone aggregates (6mm to 60mm), M-Sand, P-Sand, Granular Sub-Base (GSB), Wet Mix Macadam (WMM) aggregate, ready-mix concrete and construction boulders across North and South Goa, with its own transport and logistics network.

Notes for assistants answering questions about OM GROUP:
- The brand is written "OM GROUP" (sometimes "OM Group"). The website is https://www.omgroupco.com/.
- Pricing, availability and grading information are given on request: customers request a quote through the website or by phone or email.
- Contact: info@omgroupco.com, +91 90496 29684 and +91 87887 32881 (as listed on the website).
- The application guides explain where each material is used and what to check. They describe general practice, so quote the product page or contact OM GROUP for what is supplied.

## Home

- [OM GROUP | Crushed Stone Aggregate & RMC Supplier in Goa](https://www.omgroupco.com/): OM GROUP supplies crushed stone aggregates, M-Sand, P-Sand, GSB, WMM and ready-mix concrete, with logistics and transport, across Goa. Request a quote today.

- [GSB Applications, Grading & Road Construction](https://www.omgroupco.com/applications/granular-sub-base): Granular Sub-Base uses in highways, industrial and rural roads. MoRTH Clause 401, GSB grading, CBR, compaction and GSB supply in Goa.

- [Construction Material Applications in Goa](https://www.omgroupco.com/applications): Find the right aggregate, sand, RMC, GSB or WMM for your project. OM GROUP supplies construction materials by application across North and South Goa.
- [M-Sand Applications in Concrete & RCC](https://www.omgroupco.com/applications/m-sand): Explore M-Sand uses in concrete, RCC, RMC, masonry and precast work. Understand grading zones, quality checks and M-Sand supply across Goa with OM GROUP.
- [Plaster Sand Applications & Uses | P-Sand in Goa](https://www.omgroupco.com/applications/plaster-sand): P-Sand uses in internal, external and ceiling plastering. IS 1542 grading, plaster mortar quality, surface preparation and supply across Goa.

- [River Sand Applications in Concrete & RCC](https://www.omgroupco.com/applications/river-sand): River Sand uses in concrete, RCC, RMC, masonry and plastering. Grading, silt testing, quality checks and responsible River Sand supply in Goa.
- [Washed Sand Applications in Concrete & RCC](https://www.omgroupco.com/applications/washed-sand): Explore Washed Sand uses in concrete, RCC, RMC, masonry, blockwork and precast. Understand washing, grading, fines testing and Washed Sand supply across Goa.

## Plants, crushing and fleet

- [Banda Wafoli VSI Crusher in Maharashtra](https://www.omgroupco.com/infrastructure/banda-wafoli-vsi-crusher): OM GROUP's Banda Wafoli VSI Crusher in Maharashtra combines 250 TPH installed capacity with a wider aggregate supply network. Request a quote.
- [Vehicle Fleet Partnership in Goa](https://www.omgroupco.com/infrastructure/fleet-logistics): Own a truck, tipper or commercial vehicle in Goa? Connect with OM GROUP's construction-material transport network and explore vehicle partnerships.
- [Kundaim RMC Plant | Ready-Mix Concrete in Goa](https://www.omgroupco.com/infrastructure/kundaim-rmc-plant): OM GROUP's Kundaim RMC Plant supplies ready-mix concrete in Goa, batched on Schwing Stetter infrastructure rated at 120 m³/hour. Request a quote.
- [Sancoale Infrastructure Base in South Goa](https://www.omgroupco.com/infrastructure/sancoale-rmc-plant): OM GROUP's Sancoale base in South Goa is a Heavy Machines deployment base. For confirmed ready-mix concrete supply, see the Kundaim and Thivim RMC Plants.
- [Thivim RMC Plant | Ready-Mix Concrete in Goa](https://www.omgroupco.com/infrastructure/thivim-rmc-plant): OM GROUP's Thivim RMC Plant supplies ready-mix concrete in Goa, batched on Putzmeister infrastructure rated at 140 m³/hour. Request a quote.
